calibration_population: First-winter competition development stations only, shared across baseline and candidates. External training rows never calibrate themselves.
candidate_training: Competition first-winter rows plus external first-winter rows outside both the outer reserved group and inner validation group.
selection: For each reserved group, compare two candidates with the baseline on only the other three external first-winter groups. Fit, calibration and selection exclude every observation in the outer reserved group. Select only a candidate with strictly fewer FP and FN on the same gold rows; otherwise keep baseline.
threshold_policy: Daily station-macro F1 threshold from competition-station inner OOF only, using the existing complete-day provisional rules.
dynamic_reference_pool: Fourteen competition development RWIS stations only; held calibration stations are excluded fold-wide. External state/temperature is never an input.
limits: This experiment does not update the original frozen model or threshold.
HGB weighted scores are not calibrated icing probabilities or operating risk grades.
Positive and negative target codes retain official competition semantics.
First-winter nested validation is development evidence; a later frozen reserved-winter test is still required.
